snippet.title: Windpunk Name Reveal Trailer: The Future of the Wasteland
snippet.description:
I’m excited to introduce Windpunk, the new name for what was formerly Wasteland Waste Disposal.

This change better reflects the heart of the game: a cozy survival crafting experience focused on healing a windy, apocalyptic world using renewable energy, gliders, and a moving Mech-Ark.

#Windpunk #IndieGame #SurvivalCraft #EcoGame #Glider
